doc: The Inheritance Wake (slug inheritance-wake) — slot 2 of the expert-everyday-3 batch (THR-1680).
systems READY WITH CAVEATS, package critic PACKAGE PASS).
drifted: a stranger strikes the bargain that holds a family together, and the price is whose terms.
Shape: Personality Fork on `loyalty_ambition` (Heart's own axis). Sworn (positive, also fallback) holds
the eldest to the widow's terms (heart 0.66); Renegade (negative) writes a fair split the youngest must
sign (gold 0.62). Step 0 heart 0.60. Mean 0.63; roll-spread reads step 0 only (0.60).
Consequence hand: relationship (bond_change) + membership (membership_change join temple_of_spheres,
the local congregation as the parish), wired on both arms. Loss bonds are sentiment-only plus a
person reputation_with, because bond trust clamps at zero on a fresh edge (systems § 3).
Narrator checklist: P1 arrival with {location}; P2 costs already paid; P3 one stake (unmitigated risk);
one named person per beat; no interior sensation; no numerals; annotation clauses 0.

stakes.goal: keep a farmer's family whole through his wake
stakes.risk: see the wake end in blows beside the coffin
stakes.won: kept the farm whole and the family at the grave
stakes.lost: left the eldest still claiming the whole farm
stakes.lostBadly: let the wake end in a quarrel no one could stop

negative.won: wrote a fair split that all three children signed
negative.lost: came away with no deed and the family still quarrelling
negative.lostBadly: let the wake end in a quarrel no one could stop

template.name: The Inheritance Wake

openings.rural: {actor} comes to a farm near {location} on the night of a wake.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
The farmer is dead and lies in the barn. His three children are already quarrelling over the land, and the farm is too small to feed all three. His widow, {cast:widow}, asks {actor}, who can calm a room, to keep the family whole through the night.

If it comes to blows tonight, the family will not mend.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {actor} had the three children sitting together within the hour, and the barn went quiet.
steps.successAfterimage: {actor} calmed the barn, and the children stopped shouting.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: {actor} calmed the barn, but only after the middle child walked out into the yard.
steps.failureAfterimage: The shouting stopped when {actor} spoke, and started again when {actor} sat down.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The quarrel came to blows beside the coffin, in front of the whole wake.

nudges.name: Remember The Dead
nudges.effectLine: Fill the room with old memories of the one who died, so tempers cool. Grief for one shared loss pulls a family together.

bandProse.success: The middle child told an old story about the farmer, and the whole barn laughed.
bandProse.near_miss: The old stories quieted the barn, until the last one started the quarrel again.
bandProse.failure: The old stories only reminded each child what they had been promised.

nudges.name: Stoke Their Pride
nudges.effectLine: Fire up a wish to be the one who settles things, so they speak over the noise. Wanting credit, they care less for old wishes.

bandProse.critical_success: {actor} spoke over every voice in the barn, and every voice stopped.
bandProse.success_at_cost: {actor} spoke over the children, and the widow did not like the tone.
bandProse.failure: {actor} spoke loudly, and the children only shouted louder.
bandProse.critical_failure: {actor} spoke over the widow, and the whole barn turned on {actor}.

positive.narrativeTemplate: {actor} backs the widow's wish: keep the farm whole under her, and have all three children work it. By custom the whole farm passes to the eldest, {cast:eldest}, who promised the farmer to look after the others and now refuses the widow's wish in front of the wake.
positive.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {cast:eldest} gave up the claim in front of the wake and shook hands with the youngest.
positive.successAfterimage: {cast:eldest} agreed to the widow's terms and sat back down.
positive.successAtCostAfterimage: {cast:eldest} agreed to the widow's terms near dawn, after a night of hard words.
positive.failureAfterimage: {cast:eldest} would not give up the claim, and left the wake before the burial.
positive.criticalFailureAfterimage: {cast:eldest} left the wake swearing to take the farm by law, and the middle child went too.

nudges.name: Soften A Hard Heart
nudges.effectLine: Warm the one holding out toward the family, so a kind word lands where an argument would not.

bandProse.success: {cast:eldest} heard the youngest out to the end, and did not interrupt.
bandProse.near_miss: {cast:eldest} softened toward the widow, but not toward the others.
bandProse.failure: {cast:eldest} softened, was ashamed of it, and dug in harder.

nudges.name: Call The Promise
nudges.effectLine: Make an old vow weigh on whoever gave it, so breaking it before witnesses is hard to do.

bandProse.critical_success: {cast:eldest} spoke the promise aloud and gave up the claim before anyone asked.
bandProse.success_at_cost: {cast:eldest} kept the promise, but asked for the best field in return.
bandProse.failure: {cast:eldest} said the promise was to look after them, not to share with them.
bandProse.critical_failure: {cast:eldest} said the farmer had asked for no promise, and called the widow a liar.

negative.narrativeTemplate: {actor} sets the widow's wish aside and offers to settle the land in writing. The eldest would keep the farm whole, and the other two would take written shares of its harvests. The youngest, {cast:youngest}, has old grudges against the eldest and will sign only if the shares are fair.
negative.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {actor} wrote terms all three children signed before the burial, and {cast:youngest} signed first.
negative.successAfterimage: {actor} wrote fair terms, and all three children signed them.
negative.successAtCostAfterimage: All three signed by dawn, but only after {actor} cut {cast:youngest}'s share to win the eldest's mark.
negative.failureAfterimage: {cast:youngest} read the terms and would not sign them.
negative.criticalFailureAfterimage: {cast:youngest} tore up the terms in front of the wake and said {actor} had sold the share to the eldest.

nudges.name: Weigh Every Share
nudges.effectLine: Set each sum plain before them, so the parts add up and each party can check them.

bandProse.success: {actor} had every field's yield right, and {cast:youngest} could find no fault in the sums.
bandProse.near_miss: {actor} had the yields right, but the eldest argued every one of them.
bandProse.failure: {actor} had the yields right, and {cast:youngest} still thought the shares were small.

nudges.name: Dim Old Grudges
nudges.effectLine: Dull each person's memory of past slights, so terms are read as terms and never as insults.

bandProse.critical_success: No one raised an old slight all night, and the signing went quickly.
bandProse.success_at_cost: No one raised an old slight, but the widow raised the farmer's wishes instead.
bandProse.failure: The children forgot old slights, and found new ones in the terms.
bandProse.critical_failure: The children forgot old slights, and {cast:youngest} called the terms the worst slight yet.

traitVariants.factorLine: Being Loyal, they know what a family owes its dead.
Being Disloyal, they do not much care whose side wins.

template.description: A two-step Heart test for an expert at a farmer's wake: calm a family quarrelling over a farm too small to feed three, then settle it. The mortal either keeps faith with the widow and holds the eldest heir to her terms, or sets her wish aside and writes a fair split the youngest must sign (a Gold test). A win leaves a bond with one of the children, a place on the parish roll of the Temple of the Spheres and the village's regard; a loss costs standing with the village and one named person's trust.
